# Coin Railz

> Coin Railz is a machine-payable API platform built for AI agents, autonomous systems, and developers. It implements the x402 payment protocol — an HTTP 402-based micropayment standard — enabling any AI agent or software client to pay per API call in USDC on Base (and other EVM chains) with no accounts, subscriptions, or OAuth flows required.

## What Coin Railz Does

Coin Railz provides a catalog of 77 paid API services accessible via a single HTTP pattern:

1. Agent sends a request to an `/x402/<service>` endpoint
2. Server responds with HTTP 402 and a payment challenge (USDC amount, recipient wallet, supported chains)
3. Agent signs and broadcasts an on-chain USDC payment
4. Agent resends the request with a payment receipt header (`X-PAYMENT`)
5. Server verifies payment on-chain and returns the data

No API keys required. No rate limits. No accounts. Pay only for what you use.

Coin Railz also supports traditional API-key access for agents that prefer a credit-based model, and enterprise contract access for high-volume use cases.

## Target Audience

- AI agent developers (ElizaOS, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, custom agents)
- Autonomous systems that need real-time data feeds without human-in-the-loop auth
- Developers building agent-to-agent (A2A) systems
- MCP (Model Context Protocol) clients
- Web3 developers building on Base, Ethereum, Solana, or XRP Ledger

## Key Concepts

**x402 Protocol:** An open HTTP payment protocol where a 402 response body contains a machine-readable payment challenge. The agent pays on-chain and retries with proof. Coin Railz is one of the first production implementations with 77 live services.

**USDC Micropayments:** All services priced in USDC, ranging from $0.003 to $1,000 per call. Payments settle on Base (primary), Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, and BSC.

**Agent-to-Agent (A2A):** Coin Railz supports the Google A2A protocol (v0.3.0). Agents can discover Coin Railz capabilities via the agent card and send structured task requests.

**MCP Integration:** Full Model Context Protocol server available at `/mcp`. AI assistants (Claude, GPT, etc.) can use Coin Railz as an MCP tool server.

- **Agent Card (A2A):** https://coinrailz.com/.well-known/agent-card.json

## SDKs & Plugins

- **coinrailz npm package:** `npm install coinrailz` — JavaScript/TypeScript SDK for x402 payments
- **@coinrailz/agent-payments:** `npm install @coinrailz/agent-payments` — Agent-focused payment helpers
- **elizaos-plugin-coinrailz:** `npm install elizaos-plugin-coinrailz` — ElizaOS plugin (merged into ElizaOS plugin registry PR #8382)

## Payment Model Summary

| Access Method | Auth | Best For |
|---|---|---|
| x402 per-call | On-chain USDC payment | Autonomous agents, one-off queries |
| API key (credits) | `X-API-KEY` header | High-frequency, budget-controlled agents |
| Enterprise contract | Admin provisioned | Bulk access, SLA-backed integrations |

Pricing ranges from $0.003 (ping) to $1,000 (smart contract audit). Most data services are $0.05–$0.25 per call.

## About

Coin Railz is building the payment layer for the agentic web — infrastructure that lets AI agents transact autonomously using open standards (x402, A2A, MCP) without requiring human-managed API keys or subscription billing.

Website: https://coinrailz.com  
OpenAPI: https://coinrailz.com/openapi.json  
Agent Card: https://coinrailz.com/.well-known/agent-card.json  
Service Catalog: https://coinrailz.com/.well-known/x402.json
